answer: The relic register is checked at draw time, falcon lists the eligible set, and dawn seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 86 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 86 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an adversary pays for every seat it wants. Honest users pay that once, farms 39 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
